# `SessionOwnershipException`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Exception\SessionOwnershipException`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/Exception/SessionOwnershipException.php) — **Extends:** `RuntimeException`

A capability call arrived with a client identity different from the one the
session was created by. The session-to-client binding is immutable — this is
either a hijack attempt with a leaked session id or a broken embedding, and
both must fail closed.

No public properties or methods beyond the constructor.
